requirements.title: Private repository safety baseline
requirements.summary: Private single-repository bootstrap with secret, protected-source, license, dependency and history controls.

requirements.title: Autonomous current-control registers
requirements.summary: Versioned machine-readable gates, slices, backlog, decisions, risks, tests, evidence, agents and external state.

requirements.title: Read-only local PM dashboard
requirements.summary: Thirteen semantic control views with actual-artifact evidence explorer, explicit uncertainty and exact source drilldown.

requirements.title: Evidence integrity and privacy boundary
requirements.summary: Absolute contained sources, mandatory SHA-256 and observation time, redaction, ignored local snapshot and no mutations.

tests.title: Deterministic local CI suite
tests.summary: Formatting, lint, governance, schema, boundaries, two secret scanners, dependency/license, type, unit, component, accessibility, adversarial and build checks exit zero.

tests.title: Current snapshot source verification
tests.summary: Every rendered source reference resolves inside an allowlisted root and matches its mandatory SHA-256.

tests.title: Real-browser responsive and navigation check
tests.summary: System Chrome headless validated mobile and desktop overflow plus navigation across all thirteen views; two Playwright tests exited zero.

risks.summary: Repository protection settings are not yet independently observable.
Infrastructure preflight is blocked by API, budget, quota, inventory, and IaC gaps.
Brand font licensing is unresolved; dashboard uses system fallbacks.

costs.reason: No deployed MatchBASE workload and no budget visibility.

evidence.title: Independent security/privacy/IAM audit
evidence.summary: Current pre-QA bytes passed with zero critical, major and minor defects; later integrated bytes require final critic reproduction.

evidence.title: Independent AI/evidence/provider-routing audit
evidence.summary: Provider-route, evidence-state and redaction controls passed with zero critical, major and minor defects.

evidence.title: Independent QA/red-team correction loop
evidence.summary: S0-QA-L2 is active; no PASS is claimed until the current-byte re-audit closes.
